title: The Shrinking Curse
story: The evil wizard Halfling has cursed the village guardian — a gentle stone giant who is 64 feet tall. Every hour, the curse shrinks the giant to half his size! Mr 6 gallops for the wizard's tower, but the journey will take 3 hours.
question: How tall, in feet, will the stone giant be when Mr 6 reaches the tower?
hint: Cut 64 in half once for each hour: 64 becomes 32, then... halve it 3 times in all.
victory: Mr 6 shatters the wizard's shrinking wand just in time! At 8 feet the giant can still step over the castle wall — and as the curse unwinds, he grows back taller with every sunrise.
